64-5612-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
64-5612-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Kudo, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Warden of the Eye token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1586-2226-5921.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
1586-2226-5921.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Fractured Realm.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Silver Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Silver Drake enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

2638-3510-4875-6291.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Conspiracy.
2638-3510-4875-6291.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Conspiracy and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Tracker to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Tireless Tracker trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Stridehangar Automaton.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

539-1462-3821-4679-5256.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-1462-3821-4679-5256.description:
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, causing a player to mill card(s).
Repeat

4490-7451--210.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4490-7451--210.description:
Give Shalai and Hallar lifelink, if needed.
Gain life.
Blech triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing damage to an opponent and causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 3.
4490-7451--210.notes: Additional mana and/or prerequisites may be required depending on the method used to give Shalai and Hallar lifelink.

1687-4247-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat from step 3.

728-967-2097-3809-7087.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

710-728-2843.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

765-1993-7857.easyPrerequisites: You control eight or fewer lands.
765-1993-7857.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life by tapping it, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life.
Repeat.

1090-1895-6626-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1368-4460-6321-6723.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4460-6321-6723.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2724-4064-6432.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Abuelo. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Doorkeeper Thrull.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

891-3055-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Repeat.

891-1703-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Fool's Demise's first and second ability triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Fool's Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise ability, doing nothing,.
Repeat.

4050-5170-6132-6634.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-2734-3899-4552-6753.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Cyberdrive Awakener.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3490-4017-4659-5870.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4017-4659-5870.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

147-4050-6928.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-4050-6928.description:
Cast Prison Break either from your hand by paying {4}{B} or from your graveyard for its mayhem cost by paying {3}{B}, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Prison Break.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Prison Break, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Prison Break copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-4050-6928.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if Prison Break is in your graveyard.

339-677-1753-2511.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1537-2034-4613-4679--128.manaNeeded: {2} plus enough mana to activate the Licid's ability
1537-2034-4613-4679--128.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to activate the Licid's ability.
1537-2034-4613-4679--128.description:
Activate Zealous Conscripts using the Licid's ability by paying its activation cost, attaching Zealous Conscripts to Yenna and causing Zealous Conscripts to become an Aura.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Zealous Conscripts.
When the Zealous Conscripts token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Zealous Conscripts token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

4679-6575.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Esper Terra.
When the Esper Terra token enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of itself with haste and four lore counters on it.
When the new Esper Terra token enters the battlefield, its first, second, third and fourth chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the first and second trigger, creating token copies of any nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the fourth trigger, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G} and exile the Esper Terra token.
Resolve the third trigger, creating a token copy of the Esper Terra token created in step 1 with haste and four lore counters on it.
Repeat from step 3.
4679-6575.notes: If you do not control other nonlegendary enchantments, this combo creates a mandatory infinite loop that'll end the game in a draw unless one of the combo pieces are removed from the battlefield.

2178-4681-5686-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with mana value 4.
2178-4681-5686-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with mana value 4.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the creature with mana value 4 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

546-5194-6287.notablePrerequisites: At least two additional creature cards in your graveyard.
546-5194-6287.description:
Cast Mimeoplasm by paying {4}{B}{G}{U}
As Mimeoplasm enters, exile Ramos, Dragonsguard Elite, and two additional creature cards from your graveyard, causing Mimeoplasm to enter with twelve +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Ramos with this ability.
Activate Mimeoplasm using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Dragonsguard Elite with this ability.
Activate Mimeoplasm using Dragonsguard Elite's ability by paying {4}{G}{G}, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat from step 3.

2131-5437-5660.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature or artifact card in your graveyard.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
2131-5437-5660.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning an artifact or creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Thran Vigil triggers. Holding priority, activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding an artifact or creature card.
Resolve the Thran Vigil ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Repeat from step 2.

3951-4875-5256-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
3951-4875-5256-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

2018-5263-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a flying counter on it.
Resolve both Shilgengar abilities from steps 1 and 3
Repeat.

1283-2816-4832.notablePrerequisites:
Ensoul Artifact and Umbral Mantle attached to Chromatic Orrery.
Chromatic Orrery does not have summoning sickness.
1283-2816-4832.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Chromatic Orrery by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability.

360-859-4702.notablePrerequisites:
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
Splinter Twin attached to Lurking Roper.
360-859-4702.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself.
When the Lurking Roper token enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Each Lurking Roper you control triggers, untapping themselves.
Repeat.

3340-3542-3809.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
3340-3542-3809.description:
Activate six lands by tapping them, creating six Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {8}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Repeat.

647-890-2034-5003.notablePrerequisites: Nim Deathmantle attached to Palladium Myr.
647-890-2034-5003.description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Palladium Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Palladium Myr dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Palladium Myr from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

3554-3617-5156.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Cast Increasing Ambition by paying its mana cost, searching your library for Seasons Past and putting into your hand.
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Increasing Ambition and Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand and putting Seasons Past onto the bottom of your library.
Repeat.
